_comment: Surfaces the owner commits, not the agent. Each entry is a glob the agent may not Edit/Write/NotebookEdit without a one-time consent file. Paths are matched against the tool's file_path, both as given and relative to the project root, with forward slashes. Adapt these globs to your own protected files; these examples follow the sample vault (persona: Maya Okonkwo, a landscape architect).

surfaces.label: session-state
surfaces.note: The last-session handoff note. /wrap writes it; the agent should not hand-edit it.

surfaces.label: invoicing
surfaces.note: Money. The owner commits every change to invoicing themselves.

surfaces.label: studio-hub
surfaces.note: The studio front door. One front door per area; the owner owns its shape.

surfaces.label: consent-file
surfaces.note: Consent files are owner-created. The agent must never write one itself.
